title: Interrogative adjective quel
spec: Adjectives: interrogative (e.g. quel, quelle, quels, quelles)
summary: quel means 'which' or 'what' and agrees with its noun: quel (m sg), quelle (f sg), quels (m pl), quelles (f pl).
All four forms sound the same, so the spelling depends on the noun: Quel sport ? Quelle matière ? Quels films ? Quelles chaussures ?
quel can go straight before a noun: Quel temps fait-il ? Quelle heure est-il ?
With être, quel agrees with the noun after the verb: Quelle est ta couleur préférée ? Quels sont tes passe-temps ?
quel can follow a preposition: À quelle heure ? De quelle couleur ? Dans quel pays ?
In exclamations, quel + noun means 'What a ...!' or 'What ...!', with no un or une: Quelle belle vue ! Quel dommage !
quel always goes with a noun; for 'what' with just a verb use qu'est-ce que: Qu'est-ce que tu fais ?

cards.front: What are the four forms of quel, and why do they matter if they sound the same?
cards.back: quel (m sg), quelle (f sg), quels (m pl), quelles (f pl). They are all pronounced the same, but in writing quel must agree with its noun: Quel film ? Quelle émission ? Quels jeux ? Quelles couleurs ?

cards.en: What films do you like watching?

cards.prompt: ___ chaussures vas-tu acheter pour la fête ?
cards.en: Which shoes are you going to buy for the party?

cards.prompt: Dans ___ pays aimerais-tu travailler plus tard ?
cards.en: Which country would you like to work in later on?
cards.why: pays is masculine singular – the -s is part of the word: quel.

cards.front: How does quel agree in a question with être, such as 'What is your favourite colour?'
cards.back: quel agrees with the noun after être: Quelle est ta couleur préférée ? (couleur, f sg). Quels sont tes passe-temps ? (m pl). Quelles sont tes matières préférées ? (f pl).

cards.why: quel agrees with the noun after être: couleur is feminine singular, so quelle.
passe-temps is masculine, and sont shows it is plural here: quels.

cards.prompt: ___ sont les avantages d'habiter à la campagne ?
cards.en: What are the advantages of living in the countryside?
What time does the film start?
cards.why: heure is feminine singular: à quelle heure.

cards.front: How do you use quel in exclamations?
cards.back: quel + noun (+ adjective) means 'What a ...!' or 'What ...!', with no un or une: Quel dommage ! (What a pity!) Quelle belle journée ! (What a lovely day!) Quels beaux paysages ! (What beautiful scenery!)

cards.en: What a beautiful view from your bedroom!
cards.why: Exclamatory quel agrees with vue (feminine singular) and needs no article: Quelle belle vue !

cards.front: quel or qu'est-ce que? How do you say 'What are you doing?' and 'What film are you watching?'
cards.back: Qu'est-ce que tu fais ? – 'what' with just a verb. Quel film regardes-tu ? – 'what' or 'which' + a noun. quel always goes with a noun (or with être + a noun).

cards.instruction: Write the question this sentence answers, using quel + the noun in brackets and the tu form of préférer.
answers: Quelle matière est-ce que tu préfères ?
cards.why: matière is feminine singular, so quelle; then invert (préfères-tu), use est-ce que, or put quelle matière at the end.

cards.instruction: Rewrite as an exclamation beginning with quel, keeping the adjective after the noun.
cards.why: Exclamatory quel agrees with temps (masculine singular) and takes no article.
